messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: High error rate detected for Redwood Dedicated (eu-west-1). Affected routes: /v1/generate (model: redwood-13b-dedicated). Error 500 spike at 11:00 UTC, ~35% of requests failing for a subset of reserved customers. Pager sent to #incidents and on-call.
Sarah: oncall ack. I'm pulling logs and live traces now. tagging @Alex for infra signal.
Alex: looking. I see KV cache eviction errors and repeated OOMs on a subset of GPU hosts after the 02:45 kernel/driver roll on those nodes. Not the whole fleet — about 6 hosts in eu-west-1.
Sarah: confirmed. Repro with a synthetic replay. Failing calls show `kv_cache_allocate: failed` then fallback path that throws 500.
Priya: high level: we need (1) immediate customer-facing status text, (2) targeted emails to impacted enterprise customers, (3) mitigation: route impacted customers to warm fallback pool or compatible smaller model, and (4) on-call handoff plan.
Miguel: listing impacted enterprise accounts from billing/usage cross-check: 
- Acme Corp (account_id: acme-prod) — peak traffic 800r/s, uses reserved Redwood Dedicated instances in eu-west-1. Primary contact: Lina (lina@acme.com), AM: Miguel.
- BnkTrust (account_id: bnktrust-cc) — high-sensitivity financial workloads, uses private VPC overlay w/ dedicated nodes. Primary contact: Raj (raj@bnktrust.com), Compliance lead: Sara.
- HealthPlus (account_id: hp-enterprise) — PHI data, private deployment in our eu-west-1 tenant. Primary contact: Nia (nia@healthplus.org), escalation: Tanya.
Tanya: thanks. For HealthPlus we need to include compliance-safe language and explicitly say only routing change (no data movement). Also provide expected ETA for mitigation.
Sarah: mitigation plan initiated: (A) isolate the 6 bad hosts and drain traffic, (B) spin up warm fallback pool in eu-west-2 with compatible quantized variant `redwood-13b-q4-compat`, (C) apply temporary routing rule to send affected account traffic to eu-west-2 or fallback model in-region for reduced latency. Doing (A) now.
Alex: draining hosts now. Will mark hosts `maintenance` in fleet and revoke new allocations. ETA for drain ~3–5 minutes per host, then failover.
Priya: status page copy draft (short). Paste below and we can refine: 
```
Status: Partial outage affecting some Dedicated customers in eu-west-1. We are seeing elevated 500 errors for generation endpoints affecting a subset of reserved instances. We have isolated problematic hosts and are rerouting impacted customers to fallback capacity. No reports of data exposure. Mitigation in progress, next update in 15 minutes.
```
Sarah: looks good. Add note for enterprise customers: "If your organization has dedicated capacity in eu-west-1, our team may apply a temporary routing change to maintain availability. We'll send targeted notices to primary account contacts."
Miguel: drafting targeted email for enterprise accounts. Posting templates below — please review and tailor per customer.
Tanya: for HealthPlus include compliance contact line: `If you need compliance details, contact compliance@redwood.com`. Also confirm that no logs will be exported outside their tenant.
Miguel: Email template (Acme / general):
Subject: Incident notice — generation errors impacting Dedicated capacity (eu-west-1)
Body:
Hi Lina,

We're investigating a production issue affecting Redwood Dedicated instances in eu-west-1 which may cause 500 errors for some requests to the generation endpoints. Our engineers have isolated the problem to a small set of hosts and are rerouting traffic to fallback capacity.

Impact: transient 500 errors and increased latency for some requests.
Action we are taking: isolating affected hosts, draining, and failing over traffic to fallback capacity (may change region or model variant temporarily).
Estimated ETA for mitigation: 30–45 minutes. We will update you as we confirm full recovery.

If you need immediate assistance, please reply to this email or call your AM (Miguel) at +1-555-0102.

Thank you,
Miguel (Account Team)

Priya: For BnkTrust add an explicit SLA note and invite their security/compliance team to a bridge.
Miguel: For BnkTrust subject/body adjusted. For HealthPlus: see tailored language — include: "No customer data has been moved. We are routing requests only within our infrastructure; encryption and tenant isolation remain intact."
Alex: hosts drained, 4/6 drained, failover in progress. Error rates dropping to ~10% for affected routes.
Sarah: updating the public status page now using the draft. Setting next update +15m. Also creating private status for impacted customers with more detail.
Priya: internal comms: post short blurb to #all-hands and #product with link to the status page and list of impacted customers (Acme Corp, BnkTrust, HealthPlus). Keep wording high level — avoid technical logs.
Miguel: sending targeted emails now to listed contacts. I'll CC AMs and compliance as needed.
Tanya: pinging HealthPlus contact Nia via phone as well, letting them know compliance language will be attached.
Alex: failover complete for first 3 hosts. Error rate now ~3%. Continuing cleanup on remaining nodes, but service appears to be stabilizing.
Sarah: quick summary for handoff (Priya taking next oncall): 
- Incident: elevated 500s for /v1/generate (redwood-13b-dedicated) in eu-west-1 caused by KV cache allocation OOMs post-driver update.
- Impacted: 3 enterprise accounts (Acme, BnkTrust, HealthPlus) for reserved Dedicated capacity, transient 500 errors and latency increase.
- Mitigation taken: isolated and drained 6 hosts, routed impacted customers to fallback capacity (eu-west-2 / redwood-13b-q4-compat), targeted emails sent, status page updated.
- Current state: error rates down to ~3%, remaining hosts draining, no customer data exposure reported.
- Actions for oncoming oncall (Priya): monitor error rate for 30m, validate full recovery per account metrics, schedule postmortem and customer-specific follow-ups, coordinate any contract-level credits with Sales.
Priya: ack — taking over. I'll validate that HealthPlus compliance checklist is satisfied and confirm recovery with Miguel. I will post an update to #incidents in 20 minutes and coordinate postmortem owner.
Sarah: handing off full logs and trace links in DM. My shift ends; thanks team. :team-heart:
Miguel: I got the emails queued. Will follow up with BnkTrust security and HealthPlus compliance.
incident-bot: NOTE: This thread will be archived in 7 days per incident retention policy."
